name: Overgrowth
theme: Jungle wilderness: animals, plants and fungi.
rooms: 15 rooms. The first 3 fights come from the weak pool.
tests: Scaling enemies: Fuzzy Wurm Crawler, Cubex Construct, Byrdonis and the Kin all gain Strength every cycle, so long fights get worse.
Multi-enemy fights: Ruby Raiders, Inklets, slime swarms, the Kin, and the Wrigglers that burst out of Phrog Parasite.
Status cards: Slimed (slimes), Dazed (Fogmog's eye), Infection (Phrog Parasite, Wrigglers), Wounds (Vantom).

name: Underdocks
theme: Flooded ruins: aquatic and water-themed enemies.
rooms: 15 rooms. The first 3 fights come from the weak pool.
tests: Punishment for unblocked damage: Fossil Stalker gains Strength when it hits you; Gremlin Merc steals Gold on every attack.
Debuffs on you: Frail (Corpse Slugs, Punch Construct, rats, Fossil Stalker), Weak (Haunted Ship, Sludge Spinner), Smoggy (Living Fog) and Soul Siphon (Lagavulin Matriarch).
Limits on burst: Hardened Shell (Skulking Colony) caps damage per turn; bosses punish the kill (Waterfall Giant explodes) or go Intangible (Soul Fysh).
